metadata.description: Credited visual design references and a local reference board for any design brief

plugins.name: visual-inspiration
plugins.description: Finds 12–20 strong, credited references for a design brief (logos, identity, posters, packaging, type, web, app, social) from the 3–5 best-fit curated sources, downloads them locally and builds an HTML reference board with recurring patterns, creative directions, palette and type direction. Free sources only: no API keys, no logins.
